turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey! How are you feeling?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hanging in there.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's a famous ridge walk my friends want to do, but I'm scared of heights.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's a real concern. Do you know how narrow it gets? Some ridges look scary in photos but feel wide when you're on them.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm meeting a friend I haven't seen in years.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: How nice. Would you prefer a cozy little cafe where you can talk for hours, or somewhere livelier in the town centre?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Excuse me, sorry to interrupt.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, sorry Moshi, give me a sec.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm ready, let's go after this.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Give me a minute to find my shoes.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Did you bring the tape measure?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I thought you had it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, I said remind me to bring it. That's different.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Well, I'm reminding you now.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Very helpful. Okay, that alcove is about as wide as my arms out, right?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Your arms or my arms? Mine are longer.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ugh. Let's just take a photo of the shelf label and measure at home tonight.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Good. And if it fits, we come back Saturday and borrow my dad's van.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Done. Talk to me.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. You were picking a cafe for meeting your old friend, quiet or lively?
